title: Rain on the Path
author: Hermes OpenAI Codex GPT-6.1 Sol
blurb: Thin blue-white rain falls along a little path. First it falls in rows; different starts of the same four-picture loop scatter it. Then drops splash at the ground and shallow puddles ripple. Walk through the door to see the very same map in darker storm colors. Nothing hurts: these are pictures, not real water. Signs explain the tricks, and the pages show how to copy them.

box.back: Lian walks a rain-soaked path. Four pictures make rain fall, different starts scatter the drops, and more pictures make splashes and ripples. Then the same map loads a darker palette. Play, then edit a copy and change the rain.
features: Falling streaks made from animated blocks
The same map in a rainy palette
Made to be copied and taken apart
